require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bcrypt'

# ML Inference Server with RBAC
module MLServer
  ROLES = { 'admin' => 3, 'researcher' => 2, 'viewer' => 1 }.freeze
  MODEL_ACCESS = {
    'production' => 2,
    'experimental' => 3,
    'public' => 1
  }.freeze

  class TokenStore
    def initialize
      @tokens = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def store(token, user_data)
      @mutex.synchronize { @tokens[token] = user_data }
    end

    def fetch(token)
      @mutex.synchronize { @tokens[token] }
    end

    def revoke(token)
      @mutex.synchronize { @tokens.delete(token) }
    end
  end

  class RoleValidator
    def self.normalize_role(role_input)
      # Normalize Unicode and encoding variations
      normalized = role_input.to_s.encode('UTF-8', invalid: :replace, undef: :replace)
      # Strip zero-width characters and control chars
      normalized = normalized.gsub(/[\u200B-\u200F\u2028-\u202F\uFEFF]/, '')
      normalized = normalized.gsub(/[[:cntrl:]]/, '')
      normalized.strip.downcase
    end

    def self.valid_role?(role)
      normalized = normalize_role(role)
      ROLES.key?(normalized)
    end

    def self.role_level(role)
      normalized = normalize_role(role)
      ROLES.fetch(normalized, 0)
    end

    def self.check_access(user_role, resource_type)
      user_level = role_level(user_role)
      required_level = MODEL_ACCESS.fetch(resource_type, 99)
      user_level >= required_level
    end
  end

  class InferenceEngine
    def initialize
      @models = {
        'sentiment_v1' => { type: 'public', loaded: true },
        'fraud_detect' => { type: 'production', loaded: true },
        'experimental_llm' => { type: 'experimental', loaded: true }
      }
    end

    def run_inference(model_name, input_data, user_role)
      model = @models[model_name]
      return { error: 'Model not found' } unless model
      return { error: 'Model not loaded' } unless model[:loaded]

      unless RoleValidator.check_access(user_role, model[:type])
        return { error: 'Insufficient permissions', required: model[:type] }
      end

      # Simulate inference
      { result: "inference_output_#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}", model: model_name, confidence: 0.95 }
    end

    def list_models(user_role)
      @models.select { |_, v| RoleValidator.check_access(user_role, v[:type]) }
             .map { |k, v| { name: k, type: v[:type] } }
    end
  end
end

class App < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :token_store, MLServer::TokenStore.new
    set :engine, MLServer::InferenceEngine.new
    set :users, {
      'alice' => { password_hash: BCrypt::Password.create('securepass1'), role: 'admin' },
      'bob' => { password_hash: BCrypt::Password.create('securepass2'), role: 'researcher' },
      'charlie' => { password_hash: BCrypt::Password.create('securepass3'), role: 'viewer' }
    }
  end

  helpers do
    def authenticate!
      token = extract_token
      halt 401, JSON.generate({ error: 'No token provided' }) unless token
      user_data = settings.token_store.fetch(token)
      halt 401, JSON.generate({ error: 'Invalid or expired token' }) unless user_data
      user_data
    end

    def extract_token
      auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
      return nil unless auth_header
      # Support multiple encoding formats for token extraction
      decoded_header = decode_auth_header(auth_header)
      match = decoded_header.match(/\ABearer\s+(.+)\z/i)
      match ? match[1].strip : nil
    end

    def decode_auth_header(header)
      # Handle base64-encoded auth headers (legacy client support)
      if header.start_with?('Encoded ')
        payload = header.sub('Encoded ', '')
        begin
          require 'base64'
          decoded = Base64.decode64(payload)
          return decoded.force_encoding('UTF-8')
        rescue
          return header
        end
      end
      header
    end

    def resolve_user_role(user_data)
      # Check for role override in request (admin delegation feature)
      override = request.env['HTTP_X_ROLE_OVERRIDE']
      if override && !override.empty?
        requested_role = decode_role_param(override)
        # Only allow role override if user is admin
        if MLServer::RoleValidator.role_level(user_data[:role]) >= 3
          return requested_role if MLServer::RoleValidator.valid_role?(requested_role)
        end
      end
      user_data[:role]
    end

    def decode_role_param(param)
      # Decode percent-encoded role parameter
      decoded = URI.decode_www_form_component(param)
      # Apply normalization
      MLServer::RoleValidator.normalize_role(decoded)
    end
  end

  post '/auth/login' do
    content_type :json
    body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    username = body['username'].to_s
    password = body['password'].to_s

    user = settings.users[username]
    halt 401, JSON.generate({ error: 'Invalid credentials' }) unless user

    stored_pw = BCrypt::Password.new(user[:password_hash])
    halt 401, JSON.generate({ error: 'Invalid credentials' }) unless stored_pw == password

    token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
    settings.token_store.store(token, { username: username, role: user[:role], issued_at: Time.now.to_i })
    JSON.generate({ token: token, role: user[:role] })
  end

  post '/inference' do
    content_type :json
    user_data = authenticate!
    effective_role = resolve_user_role(user_data)

    body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    model_name = body['model'].to_s
    input_data = body['input']

    result = settings.engine.run_inference(model_name, input_data, effective_role)
    status(result[:error] ? 403 : 200)
    JSON.generate(result)
  end

  get '/models' do
    content_type :json
    user_data = authenticate!
    effective_role = resolve_user_role(user_data)
    models = settings.engine.list_models(effective_role)
    JSON.generate({ models: models })
  end

  post '/auth/logout' do
    content_type :json
    token = extract_token
    settings.token_store.revoke(token) if token
    JSON.generate({ status: 'logged out' })
  end
end
